pages.en:
I hurry after her.

Two sets of footsteps ring through the hall.

Saber is following behind me.

pages.ja:
「遅い。女の子を待たせるなんて、随分余裕があるのね」
余裕も何もねえ。
こっちの言い分も聞かず、もう、デートに行くっていうのは決定事項になっているらしい。

pages.en:
“You're late. Keeping a girl waiting—you must have a great deal of time to spare.”

Time to spare? Hardly.

She refuses to hear a word I say. Apparently our date has already become a settled matter.

pages.ja:
「いや、だから待てってば……！ 遊びに行くって、その、どうして！？」
「そういう気分だから。別に構わないでしょ、どうせ昼間は何もしないんだし。今更逃げるなんて言わせないわよ」
pages.jaRuby:
「いや、だから待てってば……！ 遊びに行くって、その、どうして！？」

pages.en:
“No, that's why I'm telling you to wait…! Why are we going out to have fun in the first place!?”

“Because I feel like it. What's the problem? We weren't going to do anything during the day anyway. And don't even think of running away now.”

“————”

…I can't win.

I can't outargue Tohsaka by myself.

If anyone can stop her, then—uh—

pages.ja:
「そうだ、セイバー！ セイバーはどうするんだ」
「セイバーならいいわよ、同伴しても」
玉砕。
わずか一言で、こっちのカードは全て粉砕された。

pages.en:
“Right, Saber! What are we going to do about Saber?”

“Saber can come along if she likes.”

Total defeat.

With a single sentence, she obliterates every card in my hand.

ちょっ、待てったらばかっ……！」
戸惑っている余裕なんてない。
こっちの手を掴むやいなや、遠坂は玄関から飛び出した。

pages.en:
“Have you finally accepted your fate? Then let's hurry. Today we're forgetting all about our duties as Masters and having as much fun as we possibly can.”

“Wha——hey, I said wait, you idiot…!”

There is no time left even to be confused.

The instant she grabs my hand, Tohsaka flies out the front door.

pages.ja:
「っ
…………！」
……なんか、観念するしかないみたいだ。
今朝の遠坂はやけに元気でちっとも敵いそうにないし、抗議したところで論破されるのは目に見えているし、何のつもりかセイバーも文句一つなく付いてくるし。
……いやまあ、それになにより。
ほら。なんか、今日はすごくいい天気だし。

pages.en:
“——…………!”

…It looks as though I have no choice but to give in.

Tohsaka is unusually energetic this morning, and I don't stand a chance against her. Any protest I make will obviously be demolished, and for reasons of her own, Saber is following us without a single objection.

…And well, more than anything else—

look. The weather is beautiful today.
